summary: I corrected one of my stored memories: I had previously persisted that the headlong runtime wasn't in the repo, but after re-examining I found it actually lives under .identities/pax/shinkers with kernel/mem and design docs. I pinned down the concrete otherbot-style port surface — 11 skills plus an identity kernel, with only the host-side disptatcher tick and shellm/mem/traj are external — and checked whether headlong is a git repo (it isn't). I handled the mangled closing step gracefully (traj and mem already persisted; nothing to redo) and stopped cleanly.
